title: Biography, Family Business, and Shops
summary: Biographies, family businesses, shops, and personal histories.
whyItMatters: Biographies and business stories connect people, dates, decisions, roles, products, processes, and changes across time.

mentalModel.title: Build a life timeline
mentalModel.content: Organize origin, education, important decisions, work stages, turning points, and the present situation.

mentalModel.title: Separate person and business history
mentalModel.content: Track who made decisions and how the shop, products, customers, or responsibilities changed.

ruleBlocks.title: Use biographical milestones
ruleBlocks.content: Practice geboren werden, aufwachsen, eine Ausbildung machen, gründen, übernehmen, umziehen, and sich verändern.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe a small business
ruleBlocks.content: Include location, products or services, customers, employees, opening hours, and special features.

ruleBlocks.title: Explain how work is done
ruleBlocks.content: Use passive language when the process or result matters more than the worker.

examples.de: Die Gründerin wurde 1972 in Köln geboren.
examples.en: The founder was born in Cologne in 1972.

examples.de: Nach ihrer Ausbildung eröffnete sie ein kleines Geschäft.
examples.en: After her training she opened a small shop.

examples.de: Heute wird der Familienbetrieb von ihren Kindern geführt.
examples.en: Today the family business is run by her children.

commonMistakes.wrong: List dates without explaining their importance.
commonMistakes.correct: Connect each date to a milestone or change.
commonMistakes.reason: A biography is a meaningful sequence, not only a chronology.

commonMistakes.correct: Use Geschäft for a shop/business and Geschichte for a story/history.
commonMistakes.reason: The similar-looking words have different meanings.

comparisons.summary: The passive describes production and service processes.
The communication lesson structures a coherent life and business story.
